configure.title: Chizindikiro cha masitepe
configure.description: Onetsani masitepe ngati mzere wawung'ono wa mitu womwe umasonyeza kupita patsogolo. Zomwe zili m'sitepe siziwonetsedwa m'kapangidwe aka.

configure.title: Sitepe yapano
configure.description: Sitepe yomwe wowerenga ali, kuwerengera kuchokera pa 1. Masitepe am'mbuyo amawonetsedwa ngati omalizidwa. Imagwiritsidwa ntchito ndi chizindikiro cha masitepe.
